description_en: Deletes an application. Deleted applications cannot be recovered. If you delete an application that has been published, normal business operations may be affected. Before deleting, make sure you are aware of this risk
description_zh: 此接口用于删除应用。应用删除后不可恢复，如果删除已经对外发布的应用，可能会影响正常业务。删除前请确保已知晓此风险
name: DeleteApp

parameters.help_en: The AppKey of the application. This parameter uniquely identifies an application in API requests
parameters.help_zh: 应用 appkey，接口请求时唯一标识一个应用
parameters.name: app_key

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request, used to identify a request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求唯一标识，用于识别一个请求
